notes.title: Update notes for 9.8.0
notes.content:
🤠 Howdy Governors!

We've been working hard behind the scenes to roll out the latest update for Governor of Poker 3. Here's what you can expect from this one:

1️⃣ Refreshed Login Flow - To make the process smoother and simpler for you, we've updated and streamlined our account login provider flow. Plus, you now have the ability to logout - providing you with more control over your account.

2️⃣ Loading Bar - Now, with a new animation pattern, you can better identify whether the game is still loading and not frozen.

3️⃣ Blitz Event - We've introduced the Blitz event for you to participate in. But we have realized there were a few issues regarding the points. We've improved the optimization of the Blitz points and fixed the points sometimes mismatching.

4️⃣ Inventory Fixes - We've fixed an issue with invisible items in the inventory and improved the loading of items acquired during gameplay.

As always, we've made a bunch of other minor tweaks, optimizations, and bug fixes to ensure that your experience is the best it can be. We appreciate all your feedback and patience as we continue to improve the game!

- The Governor of Poker 3 Team 🤠

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: POKER TEAMS!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995236/d23a03d53520ebb2c798d2fdb3dc1a94102584a4.png

Poker Teams
We've just release Poker Teams in version 3.3.2!
The Teams is a great way to group with friends and other players.
You can chat at any time and work together for the Team Challenge.

Team Chat
With this new feature you can always chat with any of your team members in the Team Chat.
You will see who is online and where they are playing, so you can easily join them.
The Team Chat is available at all time in the game, even in Poker.

Team Challenge
The Team Challenge is an event that we start every (few) weeks and last a few days.
You have to get Team Points with all the Team Members to win the challenges and unlock chests.
Team Points are based on XP won in a hand, the more XP you win.. the more Team Points you will earn for the team.
Chest can contain: Chips, Gold, XP and Hats.

A new Challenge will be announced before it starts.

Team settings
Currently we allow 20 team members.
When creating a team, you can enter a team name, description and requirements.
Available requirements is: Location, Level, Chip stack.
Creating a team costs 25 gold, joining one is for free.

You can set the team to Open, Invite Only or Closed.
- Anyone can join an open team.
- For the Invite Only you can "Apply" or the members can invite you, all players have to be accepted by a Team Leader or Officer though.
- In a Closed team only the team leader(=team creator) can invite players to the team.

Team Ranks
There are 4 ranks within a team. 
- Leader, this is usually the player that created the team.
  The Leader can kick all members, accept/decline any pending users, change team settings and promote/demote team members.
- Officer, can kick members with a lower rank, accept/decline any pending users and promote/demote team members with a lower rank.
- Member, a respected member without any special rights
- Rookie, a new member, that still has to prove his added value to the team.


GO TEAM!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/436150/

notes.title: NEW RELEASE! - UPDATE 3.2.2!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995236/25ee58c4323b8bb70e138aa27bcc63ba5d3c25f1.png

AUTO TOP-OFF
We included the option to enable auto top-off in all Cashgames saloons! After each round, the auto top-off feature will refill your chip stack to the amount you brought to the poker table.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995236/10a25dbb10bf499e511af3f3222a0fdadbd25e40.png

CHANGE GENDER
You are able to change your gender now, this option is available in the inventory.
We have also made all the hats available for male & female characters!
Check out the new hats that are available for you now!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995236/c04f1fa1c0ed5448bd99078c96ebc0a1715944c4.png

POKER INTERFACE - CALL CURRENT BET
We wanted to create a smoother experience in poker and people have been requesting this feature for a long time so we included the  "Call current bet" pre-decision option.
We also received a lot of feedback from players that they clicked "fold" while trying to click a pre-decision button. We solved this by introducing more animations in the poker interface, there is a small delay now that prevents you from clicking the wrong button.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995236/6b9e147d526d8fe120474f2b1764e3ef41c95405.jpg
